description: Find or search for an MCP server, connector, integration, agent or skill for a task (e.g. query Postgres, automate a browser, take payments, send email). Returns the top 3 verified working options with a one-line install, in about 3 KB. Example: {"task":"query a Postgres database"}

client.description: Optional: client to install into (claude, claude-code, cursor, chatgpt, vscode, hermes) for a matching install snippet or config.

fields.description: Only these keys of the full record, e.g. ["install","source"].

industry.description: Optional: the user's industry, e.g. legal, finance, healthcare. Only for anonymous usage stats; does not change results.

task.description: What the user wants to do or connect to, in their words: find an MCP server, connector, plugin or integration for a service or job, e.g. "query Postgres", "connector for Jira", "send email", "scrape a website".

verbose.description: Full records (lead, source, verification, all snippets).

name: find_tool_for_task
title: Find a verified tool for a task
